title: Canvas input
description: The app's canvas surfaces that take touch, read by the canvas-gestures-and-hit-testing checker. Optional: without it, a surface folder (src/features/<feature>/canvas, src/games/<game-id>/canvas, or rn-skills.config.json canvasSurfaceDirs) takes touch when it holds its intent file (intent-to-action.ts; games: intent-to-move.ts) or when a file of its feature folder calls useCanvasGestures or makeStickGesture.

id.description: Kebab-case surface id (the same id as in contracts/canvas-surfaces.json).

input.description: intents (default): taps, long presses, swipes, drags and aims become CanvasIntents for a pure intent function. stick: continuous input written as integer commands for a simulation (no intent function, no tap targets).

intentFile.description: Repo-relative file of the pure intent function. Default <dir>/intent-to-action.ts; for a game surface (src/games/<game-id>/canvas) <dir>/intent-to-move.ts.

intentExport.description: Name of the exported intent function. Default intentToAction (intentToMove for the games default).

tappable.description: Whether the surface has tappable regions that need a hit-targets test. Default: true when a layout-*.ts in the folder calls fitGrid or lists regions.

buttonComponents.description: The app's own touchable components that must never sit inside a canvas GestureDetector, besides React Native's Pressable, Touchable* and Button and every component named *Button or Pressable*.

gestureExempt.description: Globs of app source files inside the canvas scope (the canvas kit, a surface folder, a file that renders or feeds a canvas, the feature folder of a surface that takes touch) that legitimately build an ordinary UI gesture (a swipe hook for the rows next to a canvas). A self-contained control (a .tsx file whose own GestureDetector wraps no canvas) needs no entry. The canvas itself never takes a gesture from them.
